summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an Appendix 2A application to quote 129,334,163 fully paid ordinary shares on ASX at AUD 0.16 per share, issued as part of a previously announced placement and securities purchase plan. The filing is a routine listing application for equity issued in a capital raise; it does not involve a merger, tender offer, or other special situation event. The board has not recommended any transaction, and no advisors are named. This is a procedural step following a prior placement announcement, not a special situation, as the filing lacks an agreement, price premium, or strategic inflection point.
